style: Game art asset for a 2D side-view fighting game. The attached picture shows the character this part belongs to: a tall, powerfully built alien warrior officer in a uniform with a mustard-gold tunic, black shoulders, a black stand-up collar, a wide silver chain-mail sash, black trousers with a thin gold side stripe, and black shoes. Match its colors and proportions, but paint with rich texture and substance: semi-realistic painterly style; mustard wool-blend fabric with visible weave, soft folds and seams; matte black fabric with subtle sheen; heavy interlocking silver chain links; polished black leather. Paint ONE isolated component only, in strict side view (the character faces to the RIGHT of the image). A single key light from the upper right, soft fill from the left. Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF). No cast shadow, no floor, no other body parts, no text, no border.

A wide silver chain-mail sash crosses diagonally from the top of the shoulder down to the front of the waist. A small gold arrowhead badge on the upper chest.
